title: gtrack: GPlates-based Tracking of Lithosphere and Kinematics
description: A Python package for computing lithospheric structure through geological time using plate tectonic reconstructions. It uses pygplates to track seafloor ages by Lagrangian particle tracking, to advect continental points with topological plate models, and to build labelled point clouds of lithospheric properties for geodynamic models such as G-ADOPT.
